tests.title: the built account app reaches the fixture of the run
a signed-in browser enters the queue and the cutoff commits the browser engine
two explicit entries of one signed-in browser are visible at the same time
the account change hides the games of the first account and restores the registry of the next
the first account gets its game back when it signs in again
a waiting entry survives a reload without committing the browser engine
a late seat change never writes into the next account
the owner switches the own agent while the provider request is running
the owner switches the own agent between two private models and the provider answers
the feature switch route reports exactly the two switches
a guest accepts a friend invitation and both browser clients observe the same accepted move
a consumed invitation cannot be accepted twice and a guest without a credential is refused
the production interface renders the invitation link
the rendered workspace reflects the real service state
the invitation of a published link is previewed and the screen stays usable
two clicks in the same tick start one request
a guest opens the published invitation link and previews the exact invitation
a guest creates a friend link and the other guest joins the game
the review cursor holds an earlier position while the live game moves on
the first move and the opening reply are playable in the real service
the queue asks a signed-out browser to sign in and keeps friend play
